title: Đã và sẽ: past and future

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say give me —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: cho tôi] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say bill —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hóa đơn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say I'm lost —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi bị lạc.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say this street —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đường này] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say turn left —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: quẹo trái] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say hour, or o'clock —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: giờ] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Chị đã ăn chưa?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, chưa. Em sẽ ăn.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Today's structure: marking time on a verb. Put] [VI: đã] [EN: right before a verb for the past — something already done. It has] [VI: dấu ngã] [EN: — the same dipping sound as] [VI: dấu hỏi] [EN: down here in the south. Listen again.] [VI_F: đã] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: đã] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đã] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Put it in front of a verb:] [VI_F: đã ăn] [EN: already ate.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: You already know] [VI: rồi] [EN: it also means already — it goes right after the verb instead. The two often appear together, for extra emphasis:] [VI_F: đã ăn rồi] [EN: have already eaten.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: And you already know] [VI: chưa] [EN: not yet — it still asks and answers the same way as before.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now the future. Put] [VI: sẽ] [EN: right before a verb for something not done yet. It has] [VI: dấu ngã] [EN: too. Listen again.] [VI_F: sẽ] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: sẽ] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sẽ] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Put it in front of a verb:] [VI_F: sẽ ăn] [EN: will eat.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: sẽ đi] [EN: will go.]

[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Already, marks the past —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đã] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Will, marks the future —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sẽ] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Have already eaten —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đã ăn rồi] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Will eat —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sẽ ăn] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill the pattern. Already, marks the past —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đã] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Will, marks the future —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sẽ] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now say it. Already went —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Đã đi.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Will go —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Sẽ đi.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Have already eaten —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Đã ăn rồi.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Ask have you eaten yet —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Đã ăn chưa?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now reverse. I say the Vietnamese, you say the English.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: đã] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: already, marks the past] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: sẽ] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: will, marks the future] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One last time, before we move on.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: đã] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: sẽ] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Remember,] [VI: đã] [EN: and] [VI: sẽ] [EN: both have] [VI: dấu ngã] [EN: — the same dipping sound as] [VI: dấu hỏi] [EN: here in the south.]

[EN: Listen again — now you understand it.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Chị đã ăn chưa?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, chưa. Em sẽ ăn.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Your turn. Say you will eat.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Em sẽ ăn.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next lesson, your daily routine — waking up, sleeping, breakfast. One word to start —] [VI: dậy] [EN: it means to wake up. See you then.]
